checklist.item: Correlate OTDR events with route km and element IDs
checklist.note: OTDR events correlate with known splice closures and MID-PP connector; no new high loss event consistent with stable link loss ~11.3 dB. No fibre break or macrobend detected.

checklist.item: Identify single root cause and location
checklist.note: Root cause identified as transmitter degradation at A-TX: Tx power falling while link loss stable per OTDR, bias current rising, Rx power follows Tx.

checklist.item: Submit diagnosis with evidence
checklist.note: Diagnosis submitted, waiting for validation.

args.evidence: Transmitter degradation at site A. Tx power fell from ~0.4 dBm avg to -3.12 dBm avg on 2026-10-26, Rx power fell correspondingly to -14.43 dBm avg, while OTDR from A and B shows no new loss events and stable fibre attenuation. Tx bias current rising to ~71.43 mA avg indicates ageing laser.
